create_readout_block: create a ReadoutBlock instance with global, GNN, and regularization config objects
run_readout_block_forward: run the ReadoutBlock forward pass with graph data, node features, and edge features
build_global_readout: build a global readout using compilable scatter reduction on node features by graph batch
build_node_readout: build a node readout by applying residual feedforward with pre-normalization on node features
build_edge_readout: build an edge readout by applying residual feedforward with pre-normalization on edge features
